pages.text: Refined Blaze Ember Fuel is a potent source of energy. It is produced by processing Unrefined Blaze Ember Fuel, which is obtained by dropping $(l:res_coal_t2)Blaze Ember$(/l) into $(l:res_polymorphic_fluid)Polymorphic Fluid$(/l). Place this mixture beside a Blazebloom Goo block to refine it.
Refined Blaze Ember Fuel is an efficient fuel, and can be used to generate energy in the $(l:mach_generatorfluidt1)Fuel Generator$(/l).
